name: Fotogalleriet
funding: Arts and Culture Norway (Kulturdirektoratet), City of Oslo; non-profit foundation.
watch: Oldest institution for lens-based and photographic art in the Nordic region; artist-run, public funded.

name: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme)
funding: Arts Promotion Centre Finland (Taike), City of Helsinki, Kone Foundation; non-profit artists' association.

name: SALT Galata & SALT Beyoğlu
funding: Founded and funded by Garanti BBVA (bank) since 2011.
watch: UNVERIFIED: No controversy found in a Turkish search.
records_note: SALT publishes no reports or board itself; parent Garanti BBVA posts reports 2000 to 2025, accounts and a board list; SALT names supporters.

name: TheCube Project Space
funding: National Culture and Arts Foundation (NCAF), Department of Cultural Affairs Taipei City Government; non-profit art space.
watch: Leading independent space in Asia for sound studies, Cold War decolonization, and critical trans-local dialogue.

name: Jim Thompson Art Center
funding: Run by the James H.W. Thompson Foundation, which says it relies entirely on its own funding.
watch: The foundation also supervises the Jim Thompson House Museum. The claim that house-museum income pays for the centre is not on its page.
records_note: The art centre publishes nothing itself; its parent foundation lists seven trustees, says it funds itself, and shows no reports, accounts or donors.

name: Post-Museum
funding: Independent community-supported collective, self-sustaining micro-initiatives; 0% corporate co-optation.
watch: Singapore's relentlessly independent cultural activist collective; exploring urban commons, ecology, and repair culture.

name: Ilmin Museum of Art
funding: Run by the Ilmin Cultural Foundation, a non-profit founded in 1994 in memory of Dong-A Ilbo president Kim Sang-man; the newspaper entrusted works to the collection.
watch: The draft's newspaper-family funds claim has no source.
records_note: Its site and foundation page carry history, awards and collection notes only: no annual reports, accounts, sponsors or board.

name: Townhouse Gallery
funding: Small independent non-profit founded 1998 by William Wells, now a foundation; no funder list found and its website no longer resolves.
watch: Foundational independent non-profit in Egypt; catalyzed the independent Arab contemporary art movement since 1998. Egypt's first independent contemporary art space; closed after a state raid in 2015, then ran from a converted factory.
records_note: The gallery's own website no longer resolves and no official page was found, so its reports, accounts, funders and board could not be checked.

name: Darat al Funun (The Khalid Shoman Foundation)
funding: Private non-profit founded in 1988 by artist Suha Shoman and run by the Khalid Shoman Foundation, set up by the Shoman family. No funder list is published.
watch: Arab Bank, founded by the Shoman family, lost a 2014 US terror-financing verdict (overturned 2018). No source shows the bank funds Darat al Funun.
records_note: Its site posts no annual reports, accounts, funder list or board; it names only the Khalid Shoman Foundation as its parent.

name: Bikini Wax EPS
funding: Artist cooperative collective dues, grassroots patrons; 0% state co-optation or corporate sponsorship.

name: CRAC Valparaíso (Centro de Residencias de Arte Contemporáneo)
funding: Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Cultural y las Artes (FONDART), international research fellowships; non-profit research collective.
watch: Fiercely independent urban research platform on the hills of Valparaíso; right-to-the-city pedagogical interventions.
